verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships its own built-in AI features that handle specific tasks: a 'Draft with AI' button for retrospective answers, auto-generated incident summaries, a Copilot that suggests related incidents, and an AI Scribe that transcribes incident meetings. These are fixed, feature-specific automations rather than a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: a general-purpose conversational or agentic assistant that accepts open-ended delegated tasks, AI that executes actions (rather than drafting or suggesting), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: you can use AI to generate draft answers for individual questions
FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to your existing and previous incidents and makes suggestions in the Command Center and Slack.
After enabling, the FireHydrant Scribe will be invited to your meetings to capture crucial discussions and decisions made during incident bridges
Summaries are created as soon as an incident is declared, providing key information right from the start.
